sprint_goal: Ship all four v7.5 UI feature expansions — global command palette, user-defined price alerts, bulk actions, and saved filters/calendar view — each fully wired to its now-locked design artefact and observable in the running app.

ST-01.title: Wire global Cmd/Ctrl-K command palette
ST-01.notes: Reclassified from sprint_backlog.md's placeholder delegated_frontend to autonomous per LL-v2.3-CL-01 (frontend default-autonomous model) — existing shadcn Command primitive at src/components/ui/command.js is unwired but present; spec is locked; no external frontend ownership genuinely required. All 3 AC verified live: npm install added cmdk (readiness-pass-flagged gap), dev server started and all 12 Playwright scenarios (SC-CP-01..12) run against it and pass; keyboard-shortcuts/smoke/sidebar-nav-groups regression suites re-run clean (20 passed, 2 pre-existing skips unrelated to this change). Deviation check: implementation intent matches spec throughout with one noted divergence — ux_spec.md assumed a `/trade-plans/{id}` path-param detail route; the app's actual TradePlan detail route is query-param based (`/TradePlan?edit={id}&ticker=...&market=...`, confirmed via TradePlans.js's existing Edit-button navigation). Intent (navigate directly to that plan's detail view, ID already known) matches — per LL-v3.4-P3-03 this is recorded as an implementation note, not a filed spec deviation. Also fixed a pre-existing bug in src/utils/index.js createPageUrl (TradePlan/TradePlans routes were missing from the map, so page-name navigation to either would have silently redirected to '/') — necessary for AC-3 to hold for all pages.js PAGES entries, not scope creep.

ST-02.title: Add user-created price-alert data model, UI, and delivery integration
ST-02.notes: Reclassified from sprint_backlog.md's placeholder delegated_frontend to autonomous per LL-v2.3-CL-01 — backend data model, evaluation-pipeline extension, and health-check surfacing are pre-scoped and locked (readiness pass, §13 PASS 2026-07-16), so engine can implement both frontend CRUD and backend integration directly. Staging-only AC (alert fires via live delivery channel) requires human staging sign-off or a filed backlog item before PR opens per CLAUDE.md §2 — tracked at STEP 3.2.A.

ST-03.title: Add multi-select and bulk-action toolbar to Watchlist/TradePlans
ST-03.notes: Reclassified from sprint_backlog.md's placeholder delegated_frontend to autonomous per LL-v2.3-CL-01 — pure client-side interaction pattern against existing app data, spec locked.

ST-04.title: Add named saved filter presets and a calendar view
ST-04.notes: Reclassified from sprint_backlog.md's placeholder delegated_frontend to autonomous per LL-v2.3-CL-01 — placement decision (Trade History only) grounded in design gate; persistence testable via integration test, calendar via Playwright against seeded data. Both ACs implemented: new saved_filters table (data_model.md v2.12->v2.13), GET/POST /saved-filters + DELETE /saved-filters/{id} (new saved_filters_endpoints.md v1.0), GET /reports/daily-pnl (reports_endpoints.md v0.8->v0.9, day-granularity sibling of monthly-pnl), openapi.yaml v3.10.0->v3.11.0, api_performance_baseline.md v2.13->v2.14. Trade History gained a Table/Calendar toggle (react-day-picker month grid, realised-P&L day indicators + tooltip, unrealised-P&L banner, day-click sets date filter + switches to Table) and SavedFiltersControl (save/apply/delete named presets). Also added a BLG-FE-40 localStorage envelope for Trade History's previously-unpersisted active-filter state, per the locked design's Persistence Distinction section. 9/9 new Playwright scenarios + 13/13 new backend unit scenarios pass; full regression clean (trade-history-ai-journal-summary/tax-year-csv-export/slippage-tracking/trade-plan-tag-filter/net-r-trade-history/system-status/smoke-critical-paths e2e specs; full backend pytest 686 passed, 2 pre-existing skips). test.py registered (89->93 endpoints); SystemStatus.js fallback and system-status.spec.js SC-SS-01b updated to 93. Real regression caught and fixed during verification: pre-existing tests/e2e/net-r-trade-history.spec.js (5 scenarios) crashed because its generic catch-all mock returns {data:{}} (object, not array) for any unmocked endpoint, and the newly-mounted SavedFiltersControl/CalendarView called .map() on that non-array data — fixed both fetches with Array.isArray(json.data) guards instead of the weaker `json.data || []`; full e2e suite (588 passed, 3 pre-existing skips) re-run clean after the fix. Two implementation notes (not filed deviations, intent matches spec per LL-v3.4-P3-03): (1) react-day-picker v10 was already installed (readiness pass's flagged dependency gap was already resolved before this story) but the pre-existing calendar.js UI wrapper targets an older v8/v9 API — built a purpose-specific CalendarView.js directly against v10's real API instead of reconciling the mismatched wrapper; discovered DayPicker only renders a custom DayButton when interactive (mode or onDayClick set) — added a no-op onDayClick to force this. (2) No staging-only ACs -- frontend testing gate satisfied via Playwright alone. Frontend-visible EPIC -- BLG-GOV-19 autonomous class sign-off unavailable (Criterion 3 unmet); qa_evidence_EPIC-04.md written with full AC table and Standard Sign-Off Block, Date left blank pending Director of Quality (always-human gate per §5.3) -- halting here, not an escalation.
